To verify the boundary sharpness between the ball and the hand/background, ensuring no melting or edge bleeding artifacts common in AI generation.
To audit the structural correctness of the pitcher's hands and fingers gripping the ball, as hand-ball interaction is a high-risk area for AI artifacts (fusion/missing fingers).
To perform a holistic check for any subtle texture anomalies or lighting inconsistencies across the scene.
